You are a senior design director. Design direction #7: LAPIS CELADON. PROJECT: 'SHK Islam' - Arabic-first Islamic platform (RTL, lang=ar dir=rtl) for preachers/khatibs/students. Next.js 16 App Router + Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui + next-themes (light/dark). The AI chat assistant is THE product: answers Islamic questions, cites Quran ayahs and hadiths via tool calls. REDESIGN GOAL: ChatGPT-style chat-first app. `/` = chat page. A collapsible sidebar holds the other pages (Quran browser, Hadith browser, Themes, Favorites, Search, About).

YOUR AESTHETIC SEED: lapis lazuli blue, celadon green, gold. Jewel-tone sacred geometry. Think the blue of mosque domes and lapis manuscripts: saturated lapis blue surfaces with celadon ceramic accents and fine gold linework. Rich but controlled: lapis is the hero surface color, celadon the calm secondary, gold only for fine lines and the mark. The chat feels like a jewel box. This is a COLOR-FORWARD direction, the most saturated of the fleet, executed with intent.

GROUND RULES (non-negotiable): Zero em-dashes (— or –) in any copy/docs, use hyphen. Exactly ONE accent color (gold; celadon and lapis are base/hero surfaces, gold is the accent). Calm motion: transform/opacity only, prefers-reduced-motion honored, no scroll-hijack. Saturation allowed but must never break WCAG AA contrast for text. No AI-purple gradients (lapis is blue, keep it blue). Tajawal stays as Arabic UI font. Recommend zero new dependencies.

DESIGN.md must contain, in order: (1) One-line Design Read, (2) 3-4 sentence concept narrative, (3) exact palette (light AND dark) with concrete color values for background, surface, primary accent, secondary, text, borders, (4) typography plan reusing Tajawal, (5) full layout system: chat shell wireframe (ASCII), collapsible sidebar treatment, (6) component inventory: chat input, message bubbles, tool callouts (ayah/hadith as lapis panels with gold rules), sidebar nav items, empty state, (7) motion spec, (8) corner radius + surface system, (9) 3 signature premium details unique to this direction, (10) anti-slop self-audit checklist confirming every ground rule.

Be opinionated and specific. Concrete values, not vibes. This is a real spec another engineer will implement.
